top_signals.title: Trump sued hours after new tariffs take effect, as experts say they may not hold up
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump has renewed a flurry of tariffs, including slapping 25% duties on Brazilian imports and vowing 50% tariffs on goods from Canada.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
